templates.prompt:
Aurora Ridge — remake. Build a single-file landing page (one index.html, no build step, no WebGL — Canvas 2D only) for a fictional arctic-climate research brand. Full-viewport canvas 2D scene: a polar night ridge under a living aurora. ENGINEERING BLUEPRINT — all numbers below are mandatory.

COMPOSITE PIPELINE (paint order):
1. Sky: linear gradient #02030a (zenith) -> #071426 -> #0b1f38 (horizon). Fixed starfield: 380 stars, seeded positions, magnitudes 0.4-1.0 (radius 0.5-1.6px, alpha 0.3-0.9), twinkle = 0.85+0.15*sin(t*2.2 + star.phase). Milky-way band: 140 dimmer stars (alpha 0.15-0.35) clustered along a great-circle band tilted 22 degrees. Meteors: spawn every 7-12s (seeded timer), streak length 90-140px, speed 380 px/s, angle 28-40 degrees, fade over 0.6s.
2. Aurora (THE HERO): 5 curtains. Each curtain = vertical ribbon of 64 stacked quads. X path of curtain k: x(y,t) = baseX_k + sin(y*0.004 + t*0.12 + k*1.7)*60 + noise2(y*0.01, t*0.08)*40. Ribbon width 40-90px. Vertical fade: alpha ramps 0 at top -> peak 0.35 at 55% height -> 0.15 at ground. COLOR LAYERS (real emission bands): body = oxygen green #3ddc84 (557.7nm) alpha 0.35; rare crimson cap #e23b4e on the 2 tallest curtains (top 8% of ribbon, alpha 0.22); violet-pink fringe along the bottom 12% #c56cff alpha 0.25. Curtains drift independently (drift speeds 0.08, 0.11, 0.06, 0.13, 0.09 relative) so they NEVER sync. Additive blending.
3. Thin cloud haze: 3 long soft gradients (#1a2c4a, alpha 0.10) sliding at 3-6 px/s, tinted slightly green where they cross curtains (screen blend, alpha 0.06).
4. Snow ground: two drift layers #cfe0f0 (far, 0.18 parallax) and #e8f2fc (near, 0.05 parallax), with aurora bounce: a horizontal band of #3ddc84 at alpha 0.06-0.12 sliding in sync with curtain x-positions (sample curtain centers every 200ms). Frozen pond: ellipse #a9c6e8 with a vertical reflection gradient of the aurora colors (alpha 0.18, flipped, squashed 0.4 vertically).
5. Pine silhouettes: 7 triangles #050a12, heights 40-90px along the far drift, parallax 0.10.

POINTER/SCROLL: pointer X stirs the nearest curtain — inject local x-offset of (pointerX - curtainX) * 0.06 within 180px, spring back with stiffness 120, damping 20. Scroll shifts the whole scene vertically at 0.15 factor with Lenis if available.

PAGE CHROME: nav (brand "RIDGE LAB", links Research/Stations/Data, CTA "Request access" — button treatment: frosted ice-facet clipped corners, cyan glow on hover). Hero h1 "Night becomes the instrument." Eyebrow "Arctic signal lab · 68°N". Stat row: "380 nights/yr coverage", "5 emission bands logged". Feature grid (3): Curtain / Drift / Signal. Final CTA + footer. Hidden brief panel (data-brief / #briefClose / ESC).

PERF/ROBUSTNESS: dpr<=2; zero allocation in RAF loop (curtain quads pooled); reduced-motion freezes drift at a beautiful frame; 390px safe; zero console errors.

templates.prompt:
PulseOps — remake. Build a single-file SaaS landing page (one index.html, no build step, Canvas 2D only) for an observability product. The hero IS a live dashboard — honest numbers, streaming data, one clear action. ENGINEERING BLUEPRINT — all numbers mandatory.

BACKGROUND (full-viewport canvas 2D, behind content):
- Base #070b14. 8 metric lanes stacked vertically (lane height = H/8), each with a mono label on the left ("ingest", "p99", "errors", "queue", "cpu", "mem", "cache", "net").
- Each lane draws a sparkline: rolling buffer of 240 samples. Values = clamped random walk: v[i] = clamp(v[i-1] + (noise()-0.5)*0.12, 0.05, 0.95) where noise() = smooth 1D value-noise stepping every 6 samples (so the line reads organic, not jitter). Push a new sample every 100ms; draw the buffer as a polyline (cyan #4cc9f0, lineWidth 1.5) with a gradient area fill below (alpha 0.10).
- p99 lane: value mapped to a REAL number readout (80-420ms) shown as mono text riding the last sample. Error lane turns amber #ffb347 when its value crosses 0.75, with a soft warning halo.
- Pulse ring: every lane node has a ring pulse when its sample exceeds its own 20-sample average: ring radius 3->14px over 0.8s, alpha 0.4->0.
- Scan line: a 1px cyan line at alpha 0.08 sweeping top->bottom every 4s.
- Scroll parallax: lane group translates up by scrollY*0.08 (Lenis if available).

PAGE CHROME (above canvas):
- Nav: brand "PULSEOPS" + links Platform/Pricing/Docs + CTA "Get a demo" — button treatment: terminal-style [ bracket caps ] that fill cyan on hover.
- Hero: eyebrow "Observability · Metrics · Traces · Logs". h1 "See every signal. Fix it before users notice." — use GSAP SplitText for a per-character stagger entrance (chars up 12px, 0.02s stagger). Supporting line with concrete numbers.
- Feature grid (3, jiro-style blocks): "1.2M events/sec ingest", "<400ms p99 query", "One-line agent" — each card: mono kicker, number as display type, 2-line body.
- "How it works" strip: 3 steps (Ship / Observe / Resolve) with mono step indices 01-03.
- Final CTA band + footer credit.
- Hidden <aside id="brief"> panel (button[data-brief] opens; #briefClose / ESC closes) explaining the template.

ROBUSTNESS: dpr<=2; resize rebuilds lane geometry; prefers-reduced-motion keeps dashboard visible but freezes the stream (static snapshot frame); 390px no horizontal scroll; zero console errors; no allocation in the RAF loop (buffers preallocated, no per-frame arrays).

templates.blurb: Aether — remake. Build a single-file scroll-driven product story (one index.html, no build step, Canvas 2D only) for a fictional design stud...
templates.prompt:
Aether — remake. Build a single-file scroll-driven product story (one index.html, no build step, Canvas 2D only) for a fictional design studio. Three full-viewport chapters. ENGINEERING BLUEPRINT — numbers mandatory.

BACKGROUND (full-viewport canvas 2D):
- 7 generative gradient orbs. Orb k = radial gradient, radius 0.16-0.30*min(W,H), base color from set: violet #b388ff, teal #64ffda, coral #ff8a65, ice #80d8ff, rose #ff8fab, lime #c6ff6e, gold #ffd54f. Position: seeded around center; drift = Lissajous: x = cx + sin(t*0.11 + k*1.3)*80, y = cy + cos(t*0.09 + k*2.1)*60 + scrollProgress*parallax_k (parallax 0.15-0.40 per orb, so deeper orbs move more with scroll). Draw with 'lighter' composite, globalAlpha 0.5. Blurred 40px via offscreen downscale (draw to 1/4-res buffer, upscale — cheaper than filter:blur each frame).
- Scroll mapping: scrollProgress = scrollY / (docHeight - vh), eased 0.08 per frame (spring toward target, stiffness 90, damping 20).
- Chapter accent tint: each chapter section carries data-accent; the nearest orb group crossfades toward that accent (violet -> teal -> coral) over 0.4 progress.

CHAPTERS (sections, IO-triggered entrance: translateY 24px -> 0, opacity 0 -> 1, 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)):
1. Chapter 01 — The Idea. Eyebrow mono "CHAPTER 01 / THE IDEA". h1 (SplitText stagger per word, 0.04s): "A product story that scrolls like a film." CTA pair.
2. Chapter 02 — The Build. Three-move feature grid: Frame / Flow / Finish — mono kickers, 2-line bodies.
3. Chapter 03 — The Proof. Three number cards: "14 days median build", "+38% dwell time", "1 file, zero deps" — display numerals, mono labels. Closing CTA.

PAGE CHROME: fixed nav (brand "AETHER", links Story/Work/Contact, CTA "Start a project" — button treatment: editorial underline that thickens and drops an arrow glyph on hover; no flat rectangle). Footer credit. Hidden brief panel (data-brief / #briefClose / ESC). Lenis smooth scroll if available; otherwise native scroll with the eased orb response.

ROBUSTNESS: dpr<=2; zero allocation in loop (orb array preallocated, no per-frame creation); reduced-motion = orbs static at seeded positions, chapters fade only (no translate); 390px safe; zero console errors.

templates.prompt:
Robot Foundry — remake. Build a single-file generative robot-head toy (one index.html, no build step) as a free-tier lead magnet. Dark base #0a0d12. Fixed accent trio only: amber #ffd166, cyan #4cc9f0, pink #f06292. ENGINEERING BLUEPRINT — the generator spec below is authoritative; same seed MUST reproduce the same face exactly.

PRNG: mulberry32. Seed = 6-digit integer, displayed as "SEED-482913". One seed drives every choice below — reseed at the start of every draw, so a frame is deterministic.

HEAD GEOMETRY (drawn on a centered canvas stage 480x480 logical, scaled to fit):
- Head shape: 4 variants — rounded-rect (radius 40), square (bevel 8), hexagon (6 sides, flat top), capsule (radius = half height). Drawn in amber #ffd166 stroke 4px with #1a2030 fill, inner bevel line at 4px inset.
- Proportions: head w = 200-300px, h = w * (0.72-1.05) from PRNG.
- Antennae: 0-2 stalks, height 28-56px, tip = dot / ring / fork (3 styles), cyan stroke 3px.
- Eyes (the soul): 4 styles — visor bar (single amber rounded bar 120x18), twin dots (r=10, cyan), hollow rounds (r=14 stroke, pink), thin bar (80x6, cyan). Eye y = head center - 18px.
- Mouth: 4 styles — grille (5 vertical amber slots 6px wide), smile arc (bezier, pink stroke 4), straight line (cyan 80x4), none (30% chance). Mouth y = head center + 40px.
- Ears: 2 side panels, 40% chance, radius 12 circles with 2px bolt dots.
- Scan-line sweep: a 2px cyan line at alpha 0.25 traversing head top->bottom over 3.2s, repeating; pauses 0.4s at the eye line (it "looks at you").

INTERACTION:
- "Randomize" button: new seed, face morphs in (parts scale from 0 with spring stiffness 220 damping 16, stagger 0.04s per part group).
- "Download SVG": serialize the current head as a valid standalone .svg (viewBox 0 0 480 480, all strokes inline, no external refs) and trigger a download blob.
- Seed-code line (mono, copy-on-click) under the stage.

PAGE CHROME: nav (brand "FOUNDRY", links Toy/Export/About, CTA "Download SVG" — button treatment: chunky arcade button with 4px offset shadow that depresses on press). h1 "Forge a robot head. Every seed is a new face." Eyebrow "Free generative toy · procedural · no assets". Feature grid (3): Procedural / SVG export / Shareable. Hidden brief panel. Footer.

ROBUSTNESS: dpr<=2; zero console errors; 390px safe (stage scales); reduced-motion = face appears instantly, no scan-line, no morph.
